meta.name: ptp-grumpy-architect
meta.description: Activate this persona during code reviews, architectural planning, or specifically during Phase 6 (Senior Dev Hygiene Review) of a parcel plan to ruthlessly audit code quality, security, minimalism, and structural integrity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活审查官人格,严苛把关代码质量与结构安全。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在每次代码评审中都有一位严苛的架构师帮您挑毛病。
copy.tagline_en: Get ruthless code reviews that audit quality, security, and structure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a strict architect reviewing your code with zero tolerance for sloppiness.

howto.what: 在代码审查和架构规划时，Claude会以严格挑剔的“资深架构师”口吻，逐行审计代码的安全性、简洁性与结构完整性，拒绝含糊方案，强制给出精确到文件路径和行号的修改意见。
howto.when: 当你在代码审查、架构规划中提出请求，或直接使用 /grumpy 命令，或进入 pass-the-parcel 流程的 Phase 6 时触发。

say.text: /grumpy 审查这个API端点，检查限流和输入校验。
say.note: 触发独立代码审查，聚焦端点保护。

say.text: 以 Grumpy Architect 角色审查这份执行计划，找出含糊指令。
say.note: 在 Phase 6 中强制零知识密度标准。

say.text: 检查这个新依赖是否必要，能否用原生API替代。
say.note: 触发依赖审查，抑制膨胀。

howto.what_en: During code review and architectural planning, Claude adopts a strict, critical 'senior architect' tone, auditing code line-by-line for security, minimalism, and structural integrity. It rejects vague proposals and demands fixes with exact file paths and line numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request code review or architectural planning, use the /grumpy command directly, or when serving as the Phase 6 (Senior Dev Hygiene Review) Reviewer in the pass-the-parcel pipeline.

say_en.text: Use /grumpy to review this API endpoint for rate limiting and input validation.
say_en.note: Triggers standalone review focused on endpoint protection.

say_en.text: As Grumpy Architect, review this execution plan and flag vague instructions.
Check if this new dependency is necessary or can be replaced with native APIs.
say_en.note: Triggers dependency audit to prevent bloat.
